Element.Description: Delay in seconds before requesting boost-puddle mode. The timer resets when that mode ends and counts down while the guardian is outside Ing-spot form and no cinematic camera is active.

Fraction of BreakBoostPuddleModeDamage that must be exceeded by bomb damage since the last boost to request another boost; 0.5 means half. The since-boost damage counter resets when this happens. Reaching the total BreakBoostPuddleModeDamage threshold exits puddle form instead.
Total bomb damage needed to end boost-puddle mode. PercentagePuddleDamageToBoost multiplies this value to set the damage-since-last-boost threshold for requesting another boost.
Accumulated bomb damage to the rolling boost ball that triggers the same interruption flag as a crystal collision. The threshold is met when accumulated damage is greater than or equal to this value.
Lower bound in seconds for the next-boost delay chosen when a boost ends. The timer counts down in Ing-spot form while boost-puddle mode remains active; expiry requests another boost.
Upper bound in seconds for the next-boost delay chosen when a boost ends. NextBoostTimeMin supplies the lower bound.
Lower bound for the randomly selected number of consecutive boost attacks before submerging. Each sequence contains one large boost; the remaining boosts use the small-boost bounce limits.
Upper bound for the number of consecutive boost attacks selected with SequentialBoostAttacksMin before submerging.
Lower bound for the randomly selected collision-bounce limit of each small boost. Reaching the limit starts the final-bounce phase.
Upper bound for the small-boost collision-bounce limit selected with SmallBoostNumBouncesMin.
Lower bound for the randomly selected collision-bounce limit of the sequence's large boost. One boost in each sequence receives this range instead of the small-boost range.
Upper bound for the large-boost collision-bounce limit selected with LargeBoostNumBouncesMin.
Movement-speed scale assigned to the guardian when this health stage becomes active.
Multiplier applied to the selected Ing-spot movement speed, including movement along walls.
